subject: Gartner reference coordination: SynapseAI deployment
messages:
From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@gartner.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Gartner request: reference call with SynapseAI about Redwood deployment

Hi Jordan,

I'm working on a Gartner note about inference platforms for startups scaling LLMs and SynapseAI popped up as a customer reference for Redwood. Would SynapseAI be open to a short reference call (30 minutes) to talk about their migration and perf/cost impact?

Ideal topics: why they chose Redwood, perf/latency before vs after, cost per inference improvements, and any operational lessons learned. If available, we'd like the call in the week of Aug 24.

Please let me know the appropriate contact at SynapseAI and whether they need an NDA or any prep materials. Happy to work around schedules.

Thanks,
Emily Jones
Research Director, Gartner
emily.jones@gartner.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@gartner.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gartner request: reference call with SynapseAI about Redwood deployment

Hi Emily — thanks for reaching out.

I can coordinate this. SynapseAI has been a strong reference partner for us; primary contacts are Sara Nguyen (Head of ML Ops) and Tom Halberg (CTO). I'll loop them in and propose a couple of time slots.

Attachments: redwood_reference_checklist.pdf (PDF) — short checklist to speed approvals.

Would you prefer a short agenda (15/15) or a free-form Q&A? We can do either but will draft talking points if you want an agenda.

I'll copy our CS lead Laura and our deals ops contact Karthik to help with logistics and any consent forms.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@synapseai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Halberg <tom.halberg@synapseai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gartner request: reference call with SynapseAI about Redwood deployment

Hi Jordan — happy to help. Tom and I can do a 30-minute call. The week of Aug 24 is doable; best windows are Tue Aug 25 10–12 PT or Wed Aug 26 14–16 PT.

We're fine talking about our migration, performance numbers, and ops trade-offs. We did sign a lightweight marketing consent earlier (copy attached).

Attachment: synapse_consent_form.pdf (PDF)

One ask from us: can Redwood share a short list of example questions ahead of time so we can pull metrics?

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Head of ML Operations, SynapseAI
sara.nguyen@synapseai.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@synapseai.com>, Tom Halberg <tom.halberg@synapseai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gartner request: reference call with SynapseAI about Redwood deployment

Great — thanks, Sara. Wed Aug 26 at 14:00 PT works for Emily (Gartner) and our end. I'll send a calendar invite.

Emily — attached is a short suggested agenda and a 6-question template for Synapse to prepare (latency numbers, cost delta, team before/after, KV cache usage, any tooling changes, and roadmap impact). Please let us know if you'd like additional items.

Attachments: gcn-quote-questions.docx (Word)

Karthik — can you confirm whether Synapse needs any additional vendor references/legal sign-off before the call? Laura — we may want to capture a short quote for marketing.

Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gartner request: reference call with SynapseAI about Redwood deployment

Jordan — quick notes:
- Laura, if Synapse agrees, PR will request a 2–3 sentence on-record quote after the call. We'll draft and send to them for approval.
- Karthik, check if legal wants the consent form in the contract repo; if not, we can store it in Drive (I've added a link).
- I'll prep a short case-study interest form in case Synapse wants to expand to a customer story.

Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1example/view

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@gartner.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@synapseai.com>, Tom Halberg <tom.halberg@synapseai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Gartner x SynapseAI reference call — Wed Aug 26 14:00 PT (calendar invite)

Thanks everyone — calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-event-id

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5 min intros
2) 10 min migration story + metrics (Synapse)
3) 10 min Q&A (Gartner)
4) 5 min next steps (consent/marketing)

Emily, attaching the final question template we shared. Synapse — thanks for confirming; we'll keep the call tight and share the notes/quote for approval.

Attachments: redwood_reference_checklist.pdf, gcn-quote-questions.docx

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
